page.title: 接続表現から“流れを整える”へ

analysis.summaryJa: このまとめでは、目的・譲歩・対比・時間・同一性という論理に応じて接続表現を選び、その後で文章の重なりを整える。toとso thatは目的、althoughとdespiteは譲歩、whereasとon the other handは対比、when・while・sinceは時間、asは同時や役割を示す。読みやすい流れにはoneやsoなどの代用、省略、コンマや挿入句による必要な注釈を使う。
grammarPoints: 対比を示すwhereas / on the other hand
one・so・助動詞による代用と自然な省略
挿入句・コンマによる注釈
visualEvidence: 五色の分岐路が接続関係を用途別に示している
目的・譲歩・対比・時間・同一性の各カードに短い例がある
重い反復荷物から軽い車列への変化が文章整理を表す
one・so・auxiliary・コンマの札が代用と注釈の道具を示す
診断ストリップが接続から重なり探索・代用省略・注釈へ進む
commonTraps: 目的節に別主語があるのにtoだけでつなぐ
althoughとdespiteの後続形を混同する
whereasとon the contraryの機能を混同する
同じ名詞や動詞を不自然に繰り返す
省略で主語や時制の対応が不明になる
注釈を句読点なしで挿入して文構造を壊す

questions.prompt: The company added weekend support ------- customers could receive help outside business hours.

choices.A: to
choices.B: although
choices.C: so that

questions.translationJa: 顧客が営業時間外にも支援を受けられるよう、会社は週末対応を追加しました。
questions.explanationJa: 目的節に主語customersがあるためso thatが適切です。

questions.prompt: ------- the installation took longer than expected, the system was ready before opening time.

choices.A: Although
choices.B: Despite
choices.C: Because of

questions.translationJa: 設置には予想以上に時間がかかりましたが、開店時刻前にシステムは準備できました。
questions.explanationJa: 後ろが完全な節で譲歩を示すAlthoughが適切です。

questions.prompt: The city office accepts walk-ins, ------- the airport office requires reservations.

choices.A: when
choices.B: because
choices.C: until

questions.translationJa: 市内事務所は予約なしで受け付ける一方、空港事務所は予約が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: 二つの事務所の方針を対比するwhereasが合います。

questions.prompt: Please call the service desk ------- the warning light appears.

choices.A: whereas
choices.B: when
choices.C: despite

questions.translationJa: 警告灯が表示されたときはサービス窓口へ電話してください。
questions.explanationJa: 出来事が起きる場合を時間上に置くwhenです。

questions.prompt: ------- the elevator doors closed, the floor indicator changed to 12.

choices.A: As
choices.B: Like
choices.C: Because of

questions.translationJa: エレベーターの扉が閉まるのと同時に、階表示が12へ変わりました。
questions.explanationJa: 二つの瞬間を密着させるAsが適切です。

questions.prompt: We need a larger meeting room, not a smaller -------.

choices.A: so
choices.B: do
choices.C: one

questions.translationJa: 私たちに必要なのは小さい会議室ではなく、より大きい会議室です。
questions.explanationJa: 既出の可算名詞roomをoneで代用して反復を避けます。

questions.prompt: Mina expects the delivery to arrive today, and I think ------- too.

choices.A: one
choices.B: so
choices.C: do

questions.translationJa: ミナは配送が今日届くと予想しており、私もそう思います。
questions.explanationJa: 前の節内容全体をthink soで代用します。

questions.prompt: The east branch processes more applications than the west branch -------.

choices.A: is
choices.B: has been
choices.C: one

questions.translationJa: 東支店は西支店より多くの申請を処理します。
questions.explanationJa: 既出動詞processesを助動詞doesで代用します。
questions.focus: 助動詞による動詞代用

questions.prompt: The new route is longer. -------, it avoids the busiest intersection.

choices.A: On the other hand
choices.B: On the contrary
choices.C: Therefore

questions.translationJa: 新経路はより長いです。一方で、最も混雑する交差点を避けられます。
questions.explanationJa: 一つの欠点を否定せず別の利点を加える表現です。

questions.prompt: The regional director, ------- joined the company in 2010, will lead the briefing.

choices.A: which
choices.B: who
choices.C: where

questions.translationJa: 2010年に入社した地域統括責任者が説明会を担当します。
questions.explanationJa: 人について補足注釈を加える非制限用法のwhoが適切です。
questions.focus: コンマ付き関係節の注釈

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly expresses purpose with a separate subject.

choices.A: We marked the box to the courier could identify it.
choices.B: We marked the box so that identify it the courier.
choices.C: We marked the box despite the courier could identify it.
choices.D: We marked the box so that the courier could identify it.

questions.translationJa: 配達員が識別できるよう、箱に印を付けました。
questions.explanationJa: 目的節に別主語the courierがあるためso that＋節が正しいです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly uses a noun-following concession.

choices.A: Although the noise, the customer completed the call.
choices.B: Despite the noise, the customer completed the call.
choices.C: Despite of the noise, the customer completed the call.
choices.D: Despite the office was noisy, the customer completed the call.

questions.translationJa: 騒音にもかかわらず、顧客は通話を終えました。
questions.explanationJa: Despiteはofなしで名詞句the noiseを直接受けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly contrasts two situations.

choices.A: The first plan saves time, whereas the second cost.
choices.B: Whereas the first plan time, the second reduces cost.
choices.C: The first plan saves time, whereas the second reduces cost.
choices.D: The first plan whereas saves time the second reduces cost.

questions.translationJa: 第1案は時間を節約する一方、第2案は費用を減らします。
questions.explanationJa: whereasの前後に完全な比較節を置いています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly avoids repeating a countable noun.

choices.A: This printer is faster than the old one.
choices.B: This printer is faster than the old so.
choices.C: This printer is faster than the old does.
choices.D: This printer is faster than old one printer.

questions.translationJa: このプリンターは旧型より高速です。
questions.explanationJa: oneが既出の可算名詞printerを自然に代用しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly substitutes for a previous clause.

choices.A: “Will the client approve the revision?” “I think one.”
choices.B: “Will the client approve the revision?” “I think do.”
choices.C: “Will the client approve the revision?” “I so think the revision.”
choices.D: “Will the client approve the revision?” “I think so.”

questions.translationJa: 「顧客は改訂を承認しますか」「そう思います」
questions.explanationJa: think soのsoが前の命題全体を受けています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with natural comparative ellipsis.

choices.A: Our team completed more inspections than the other team completed more inspections.
choices.B: Our team did completed more inspections than the other team.
choices.C: Our team completed more inspections than the other team did.
choices.D: Our team completed more inspections than did the other team completed.

questions.translationJa: 私たちのチームは他チームより多くの検査を完了しました。
questions.explanationJa: didがcompleted inspectionsを代用し、不自然な反復を避けています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with a correctly punctuated annotation.

choices.A: Ms. Park our new operations manager will visit the warehouse.
choices.B: Ms. Park, our new operations manager, will visit the warehouse.
choices.C: Ms. Park, our new operations manager will visit, the warehouse.
choices.D: Ms. Park our, new operations manager, will visit the warehouse.

questions.translationJa: 新任の業務管理者であるパクさんが倉庫を訪れます。
questions.explanationJa: 同格の補足情報を一対のコンマで囲んでいます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly uses a time connector.

choices.A: Call the supervisor when the inspection will be complete.
choices.B: Call when the supervisor the inspection complete.
choices.C: When complete the inspection, will call the supervisor.
choices.D: Call the supervisor when the inspection is complete.

questions.translationJa: 検査が完了したら監督者へ電話してください。
questions.explanationJa: 未来のwhen節を現在形isで正しく表しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that correctly uses “as” for an actual role.

choices.A: Like the shift leader, I am officially responsible for recording every incident.
choices.B: As like the shift leader, I must record every incident.
choices.C: As the shift leader, I must record every incident.
choices.D: As the shift leader is, every incident I must record.

questions.translationJa: シフト責任者として、私はすべての出来事を記録しなければなりません。
questions.explanationJa: 話者の実際の役割をAs＋名詞で示しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that naturally omits repeated material.

choices.A: Mina ordered the vegetarian meal, and Leo the fish.
choices.B: Mina ordered the vegetarian meal, and Leo ordered.
choices.C: Mina ordered, and Leo the fish ordered the vegetarian meal.
choices.D: Mina the vegetarian meal, and Leo did the fish.

questions.translationJa: ミナは菜食料理を、レオは魚料理を注文しました。
questions.explanationJa: 第二節で文脈から明らかなorderedを省略して対比を簡潔にしています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “We left early so that Nao could catch the last train.”

choices.A: Our early departure was intended to help Nao catch the last train.
choices.B: Nao missed the train because we left too late on purpose.
choices.C: We left after the last train had already departed.
choices.D: The train left early in order to avoid Nao.

questions.translationJa: 私たちが早く出た目的は、ナオが終電に乗れるようにすることでした。
questions.explanationJa: so that節が示す目的をwas intended toで言い換えています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Although the office was crowded, service was quick.”

choices.A: Service was slow because the office was empty.
choices.B: The crowd disappeared before service began.
choices.C: Quick service caused the office to close.
choices.D: Service was quick despite the crowd in the office.

questions.translationJa: 事務所が混雑していたにもかかわらず、対応は迅速でした。
questions.explanationJa: although＋節をdespite＋名詞句へ変えた同義文です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The basic plan is cheap, whereas the premium plan is flexible.”

choices.A: Both plans have identical prices and features.
choices.B: The premium plan is cheap because it has no flexibility.
choices.C: The two plans have different advantages: price and flexibility.

questions.translationJa: 二つのプランには、価格と柔軟性という異なる利点があります。
questions.explanationJa: whereasが二つの面を対比しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Contact us when you receive the replacement.”

choices.A: Contact us long before any replacement is shipped.
choices.B: Contact us at the time the replacement arrives.
choices.C: The replacement arrives because you contacted us.

questions.translationJa: 交換品が届いた時点でご連絡ください。
questions.explanationJa: whenが連絡する出来事を到着時点に置いています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “As the train departed, the platform lights dimmed.”

choices.A: The train’s departure and the dimming lights occurred at nearly the same time.
choices.B: The lights dimmed long before the train reached the platform.
choices.C: The train departed because all lights remained bright.
choices.D: The platform closed in order to stop the train.

questions.translationJa: 列車の出発とホーム照明が暗くなることはほぼ同時に起きました。
questions.explanationJa: asが二つの瞬間を密着して示しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I prefer the blue folder to the red one.”

choices.A: I prefer the blue color to every folder.
choices.B: The red folder is the only one I prefer.
choices.C: I prefer the blue folder to the red folder.
choices.D: I do not compare the two folders.

questions.translationJa: 私は赤いフォルダーより青いフォルダーを好みます。
questions.explanationJa: oneは直前の可算名詞folderを代用しているため完全形と同義です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Aya expects sales to rise, and I do too.”

choices.A: Only Aya expects sales to fall.
choices.B: I expect Aya to leave the sales team.
choices.C: Neither of us has any expectation about sales.
choices.D: Aya and I both expect sales to rise.

questions.translationJa: アヤも私も売上が増えると予想しています。
questions.explanationJa: doが前の動詞句expects sales to riseを代用しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Mr. Lee, the branch manager, approved the request.”

choices.A: Mr. Lee approved the request, and he is the branch manager.
choices.B: The branch manager rejected Mr. Lee’s request.
choices.C: Mr. Lee approved a request to hire a different manager.
choices.D: The identity of the person who approved it is unknown.

questions.translationJa: リーさんが申請を承認し、彼は支店長です。
questions.explanationJa: コンマで囲まれた同格がMr. Leeの役職を補足しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The first route is shorter. On the other hand, the second is safer.”

choices.A: The first route is both shorter and safer in every way.
choices.B: One route saves distance, while the other offers greater safety.
choices.C: The second route is unsafe because it is shorter.
choices.D: The two routes have no meaningful difference.

questions.translationJa: 一方の経路は距離が短く、もう一方はより安全です。
questions.explanationJa: on the other handが別の面の利点を加えています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Mina can process refunds faster than Leo can.”

choices.A: Leo processes refunds faster than Mina.
choices.B: Neither person is able to process a refund.
choices.C: Mina is faster than Leo at processing refunds.
choices.D: Mina and Leo always take exactly the same time.

questions.translationJa: ミナはレオより返金処理が速いです。
questions.explanationJa: canがprocess refundsを代用した比較節の意味を明示しています。

questions.prompt: We placed the notice near the elevator ------- every visitor could see it.

choices.A: to
choices.B: so that
choices.C: although

questions.translationJa: すべての来訪者に見えるよう、エレベーター付近に掲示しました。
questions.explanationJa: 目的節に主語every visitorがあるためso thatです。

questions.prompt: ------- the temporary closure, all scheduled appointments were completed online.

choices.A: Although
choices.B: Because
choices.C: Unless

questions.translationJa: 一時閉鎖にもかかわらず、予定されていた予約はすべてオンラインで完了しました。
questions.explanationJa: 名詞句the temporary closureを受ける譲歩のDespiteです。

questions.prompt: The north lot is closer to the entrance, ------- the south lot has more spaces.

choices.A: whereas
choices.B: when
choices.C: because

questions.translationJa: 北駐車場は入口に近い一方、南駐車場は台数が多いです。
questions.explanationJa: 二つの駐車場の特徴を対比するwhereasです。

questions.prompt: The system sends a confirmation email ------- a reservation is completed.

choices.A: whereas
choices.B: despite
choices.C: when

questions.translationJa: 予約が完了すると、システムが確認メールを送ります。
questions.explanationJa: 反復する手続きの時間位置をwhenで示します。

questions.prompt: ------- the final guest left, the staff locked the main entrance.

choices.A: Like
choices.B: Because of
choices.C: Unless

questions.translationJa: 最後の来客が退出するのと同時に、スタッフは正面入口を施錠しました。
questions.explanationJa: 退出と施錠の密着した時間関係をAsで示します。

questions.prompt: We ordered two projectors because the venue’s ------- was not bright enough.

choices.A: so
choices.B: one
choices.C: did

questions.translationJa: 会場のプロジェクターが十分明るくなかったため、2台注文しました。
questions.explanationJa: 所有格の後で既出の単数可算名詞projectorをoneが代用します。

questions.prompt: The supplier says the replacement will arrive tomorrow, and we hope -------.

choices.A: so
choices.B: one
choices.C: do

questions.translationJa: 供給業者は交換品が明日届くと言っており、私たちもそう願っています。
questions.explanationJa: hope soのsoが前の命題全体を受けます。

questions.prompt: The express team handles more packages per hour than the standard team -------.

choices.A: is
choices.B: one
choices.C: so

questions.translationJa: 速達チームは標準チームより1時間当たり多くの荷物を処理します。
questions.explanationJa: doesがhandles packagesを代用して反復を避けます。

questions.prompt: The service center, ------- opened last month, now operates seven days a week.

choices.A: who
choices.B: where
choices.C: which

questions.translationJa: 先月開設されたサービスセンターは現在週7日営業です。
questions.explanationJa: 物を先行詞とする非制限関係節の注釈にはwhichを使います。

questions.prompt: The software is inexpensive. -------, it requires extensive staff training.

choices.A: On the contrary
choices.B: On the other hand
choices.C: Therefore

questions.translationJa: そのソフトウェアは安価です。一方で、広範な職員研修が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: 安価という利点を否定せず別の欠点を加える表現です。
